Hyderabad Police Arrest Man Wanted in US Murder Probe

Hyderabad police arrested Arjun Sharma on charges of cheating. The arrest also involved executing an extradition warrant related to a murder investigation in the United States. Sharma was apprehended in Hyderabad.
